# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 13 (Bu-Vb Pc13)
**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc13
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 13
**Title (English, from literature):** Complaining

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The rule is directly tied to the thirteenth rule of the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha and corresponds to Pācittiya 109 of the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga, as well as occurrences in the Parivāra [SuttaCentral; Hüsken 1997]. Curated parallels on SuttaCentral demonstrate that this precept is shared across all major extant Vinaya traditions—including Dharmaguptaka, Mahāsāṃghika, Mahāsāṃghika-Lokottaravāda, Mīśāsaka, Mūlasarvāstivāda, and Sarvāstivāda—where it appears as either Pācittiya 12 or 13 in both the respective monks' and nuns' codes in Sanskrit, Chinese, and Tibetan [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal formulaic reuse, showing text shared with over a hundred Pali Vinaya passages (most notably Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81, 21, and 24, as well as the sub-commentary *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā*), though no automated cross-language matches met the reporting threshold [DharmaNexus].
